column1: # The fate of every file of today's build (STANDALONE-PLAN §15.4; PlanSwap-4, and the fix of its landing
# review). Read by fates.ts, which says what each field means; checked by fates.test.ts and the fence
# Every file under src/backend, src/frontend, src/shared, src/engine, src/packs, src/cli and
# src/worker, and src/backend.ts, src/frontend.ts and src/spindle-augment.ts, has one line, settled by
# its path and never by its name. A package that adds a file under those folders adds its line; one
# that moves or removes a file keeps its line, so the list ends as the report of which went (R-50).
# Every test under test/backend has a line too: removed when what it tests goes, moved to a home
# under test/ when what it tests is kept.
# Made on 15 Nov from the exact import graph and Bun's metafile of the shipped entries, and settled
# again by the landing review's fix. A kept file may still import a removed one: then the fence's
# list (not-yet-moved.tsv) holds the import, with the names it takes and the package that ends it, or
# a piece below allows those names to the files it names, until the piece moves.
